definitions.gloss: substitution; using something in place of another
definitions.explanation: The act of using one thing as a replacement or stand-in for another. Often used with する to form a suru-verb.

examples.japanese: バターの{代用|だいよう}にする。
examples.english: To use as a substitute for butter.

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}の{代用|だいよう}として{蜂蜜|はちみつ}を{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used honey as a substitute for sugar.

examples.japanese: {専用|せんよう}の{道具|どうぐ}がなくても、{身近|みぢか}なもので{代用|だいよう}できることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Even without specialized tools, you can often substitute with things you have at hand.

notes:
{代用|だいよう} means using one thing in place of another. Compound of {代|だい} (substitute) + {用|よう} (use). Commonly used as a する verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- AをBで{代用|だいよう}する: to substitute B for A
- Aの{代用|だいよう}としてBを{使|つか}う: to use B as a substitute for A
- ～で{代用|だいよう}できる: can be substituted with ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代用|だいよう}{品|ひん}: substitute product/item
- {代用|だいよう}{食|しょく}: substitute food
- {代用|だいよう}{教員|きょういん}: substitute teacher

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代替|だいたい}: replacement, alternative (broader scope; often used for systems or policies)
- {代|か}わり: replacement, substitute (more casual and everyday)
